entities.name: Urza's Assault on Phyrexia
entities.description: A major attack by the planeswalker Urza on Phyrexia, ultimately unsuccessful.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker who assaulted Phyrexia to confront the corruptors of his brother Mishra.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Ruler of Phyrexia, not a planeswalker but with godlike powers.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Failed Phyrexian sleeper agent, a Phyrexian newt, who guided Urza and retrieved her heart.

entities.name: Shard of Twelve Worlds
entities.description: Its formation locked Urza out of Dominaria.

entities.name: Fourth Sphere
entities.description: Level of Phyrexia Urza blasted down to.

entities.name: Fane of Flesh
entities.description: Place on Phyrexia holding the chamber of hearts.

entities.name: Dragon engine
entities.description: Eight-legged engine Urza built for the assault.

events.summary: Locked out of Dominaria, Urza wanders the multiverse, meets Xantcha, learns where Phyrexia is and resolves to assault it.
events.quote: he resolved to perform an all-out assault on the plane

events.summary: Urza builds a dragon engine and dons a protective suit.
events.quote: creating an eight-legged dragon engine inspired by his brother's machines of old

events.summary: Urza planeswalks to Phyrexia's surface, destroys many Phyrexians and blasts a hole to the Fourth Sphere.
Xantcha enters the Fane of Flesh, finds her own heart in the pool of hearts and returns to Urza.
events.quote: she waded into the pool of hearts and collected it before rushing back to Urza

events.summary: Yawgmoth lashes out and brushes Urza's mind, overpowering him.
events.quote: Yawgmoth brushed Urza’s mind, and Urza’s world convulsed

events.summary: Xantcha snaps Urza out of his stupor; he flees Phyrexia with her, leaving the engine.
events.quote: He realized that the assault had failed

relations.quote: the power of Yawgmoth , the plane's ruler
Yawgmoth was now aware of this dangerous and driven foe
the corruption that had overtaken his brother
